[Partial] Mount a heavy-duty garment hook and screw two brackets into the plastic lower section. [t243]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Mount the heavy-duty garment hook at the top of the rear window to support most of the panel's weight.
2. Screw two brackets into the plastic lower section of the window surround to prevent side-to-side movement.
